title: Decode Ways
constraints: s contains only digits and may contain leading zeros
description:
A message containing letters from A-Z is being encoded to numbers using the following mapping:

A -> 1, B -> 2, ..., Z -> 26

Given a string `s` containing only digits, return the **number of ways** to **decode** it.

tests.explanation: It could be decoded as AB (1, 2) or L (12).
It could be decoded as BZ (2, 26), B, Z (2, 2, 6), or BBF (2, 2, 6).
